applied.quote: A child can withdraw the contributions to a custodial Roth IRA (the dollars originally put in) at any time without the early-withdrawal tax.
applied.replacement: A child can withdraw the contributions to a custodial Roth IRA (the dollars originally put in) at any time.
applied.why: SOURCE says contributions are withdrawable anytime; it does not say tax-free.

applied.quote: Earnings taken out before age 59 1/2 are different: they can be taxable, and the [IRS adds a 10% additional tax](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc557) on the part of the distribution included in gross income, on top of regular income tax.
applied.replacement: For distributions taken before age 59 1/2, the [IRS adds a 10% additional tax](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc557) on the part of the distribution included in gross income, on top of regular income tax.
applied.why: SOURCE covers early distributions generally, not earnings specifically.

applied.quote: For distributions taken before age 59 1/2, the [IRS adds a 10% additional tax](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc557) on the part of the distribution included in gross income, on top of regular income tax.
applied.replacement: For distributions taken before age 59 1/2, the [IRS generally adds a 10% additional tax](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc557) on the part of the distribution included in gross income, on top of regular income tax.
applied.why: SOURCE says early distributions are 'generally' those before 59 1/2; hedge dropped
